description: Public scenario manifest for published-artifact saga compensation conformance. Harnesses use these scenario ids and criteria when evaluating Durable Workflow saga behavior across PHP and Python runtimes.

topology.side_store: append-only JSONL rows outside product storage used only for conformance assertions

published_artifact_install_only.expected_behavior: all artifacts are resolved from complete published channels and no local product checkout is used as an artifact under test

forward_success_path.expected_behavior: A, B, C, and D complete with no compensation rows and a completed terminal state

failure_at_d_reverse_compensation.expected_behavior: after D fails, C, B, and A compensate in reverse order and the workflow reaches a documented terminal state

failure_at_c_reverse_compensation.expected_behavior: after C fails, B and A compensate in reverse order and D is not invoked

failure_at_a_no_compensation.expected_behavior: A failing before its forward effect records no completed forward rows and no compensation rows

compensation_retry_idempotence.expected_behavior: a retrying compensation may retry the task but applies the underlying business undo exactly once

compensation_failure_visibility.expected_behavior: a definitive compensation failure is visible in the terminal failure shape and operator surfaces

mid_compensation_worker_restart.expected_behavior: after a worker restart, compensation resumes from the recorded step without duplicate compensation effects

php_workflow_python_compensation.expected_behavior: a PHP workflow can call Python compensation handlers in the correct order and observe their result shapes

python_workflow_php_compensation.expected_behavior: a Python workflow can call PHP compensation handlers in the correct order and observe their result shapes

typed_compensation_error_round_trip.expected_behavior: a typed compensation error survives the worker boundary and is visible in the workflow failure shape

operator_visible_mid_compensation_status.expected_behavior: operators can tell which forward steps completed and which compensations are running, completed, pending, or failed

scenarios.title: Published artifact install only
operations: install the server image, CLI, Python SDK, PHP workflow runtime, and Waterline from published channels
record the published and resolved artifact version for every actor
reject release tags or records whose required assets are not downloadable
run no product code from a local checkout
pass_criteria: published_artifact_versions and resolved_artifact_versions name server, cli, workflow-php, sdk-python, and waterline
all versions are concrete pins with no placeholder tokens
all actors under test came from published install channels
local product source checkouts are not used as artifacts under test

scenarios.title: Forward success path
operations: execute the BookTrip saga without injecting a failure
record forward side-store rows for reserve_flight, reserve_hotel, charge_card, and send_confirmation
record compensation side-store rows and workflow history
pass_criteria: all forward steps complete in declared order
no compensation row is written
the workflow reaches a completed terminal state

scenarios.title: Failure after later step compensation
operations: inject a failure at send_confirmation after reserve_flight, reserve_hotel, and charge_card complete
record compensation rows and exported history for the failed run
compare compensation order with the reverse of completed forward effects
pass_criteria: refund_card, cancel_hotel, and cancel_flight run in that order
each completed forward effect is compensated exactly once
the terminal state and history expose the failed forward step and compensation sequence

scenarios.title: Early compensation before confirmation
operations: inject a failure at charge_card before send_confirmation is invoked
record forward, compensation, and send_confirmation side-store counts
compare compensation order with the reverse of completed forward effects
pass_criteria: reserve_flight and reserve_hotel are the only completed forward effects
cancel_hotel and cancel_flight run in that order
send_confirmation is not invoked

scenarios.title: First-step failure has no compensation
operations: inject a failure before reserve_flight records a completed forward effect
record forward and compensation side-store rows
record the terminal workflow status
pass_criteria: no completed forward row is recorded
no compensation row is recorded
the workflow reaches a documented failed terminal state

scenarios.title: Compensation retry idempotence
operations: make a compensation handler fail once before succeeding on retry
record retry attempts and the durable business-effect count
compare task attempts with side-store business effects
pass_criteria: the compensation task may retry
the underlying business undo is applied exactly once
the workflow reaches the documented terminal state

scenarios.title: Compensation failure visibility
operations: force a compensation handler to fail definitively
record the failed compensation step and terminal failure shape
capture operator-visible status and reason through public surfaces
pass_criteria: the failing compensation step is named in result evidence
the workflow terminal failure shape exposes the compensation failure
server, CLI, or Waterline visibility reports the reason or records an unsupported-surface finding

scenarios.title: Mid-compensation worker restart
operations: pause a failed saga after refund_card and before remaining compensations
restart the worker that owns the next compensation task
resume polling and record compensation side-store counts and history
pass_criteria: compensation resumes from the recorded next step
no compensation effect is duplicated
history remains replayable after the worker restart

scenarios.title: PHP workflow with Python compensation
operations: run a PHP BookTrip workflow that dispatches compensation handlers to Python
inject a later-step failure after charge_card
record compensation order and typed result shapes returned across the runtime boundary
pass_criteria: Python compensation handlers run in reverse completed-effect order
typed result shapes are preserved when observed by the PHP workflow
runtime evidence identifies workflow-php as workflow_runtime and sdk-python as compensation_runtime

scenarios.title: Python workflow with PHP compensation
operations: run a Python BookTrip workflow that dispatches compensation handlers to PHP
inject a later-step failure after charge_card
record compensation order and typed result shapes returned across the runtime boundary
pass_criteria: PHP compensation handlers run in reverse completed-effect order
typed result shapes are preserved when observed by the Python workflow
runtime evidence identifies sdk-python as workflow_runtime and workflow-php as compensation_runtime

scenarios.title: Typed compensation error round trip
operations: raise a typed compensation error in one runtime
observe the error type and message through the workflow and terminal failure shape
record cross-language error fields without reading local source
pass_criteria: the observed error type matches the raised compensation error type
the observed message preserves the compensation failure context
the terminal failure shape exposes the typed compensation error

scenarios.title: Operator-visible mid-compensation status
operations: pause or observe a saga while compensation is in progress
capture completed forward steps, running compensation, pending compensations, completed compensations, and failed compensations
capture public server, CLI, and Waterline operator visibility snapshots
pass_criteria: operators can distinguish completed forward effects from compensation progress
running, pending, completed, and failed compensation states are observable through public operator surfaces
the visibility evidence includes Waterline selected-run detail or list evidence for the paused workflow run

host_runner_contract.release_asset_handoff_policy: do not advance to a tag until the required install asset is downloadable
